policy: Every current and future catalog game needs its own original concept-based cover, never a gameplay, settings, login or loading screenshot. Preserve historical manifests and versioned assets.

covers.title: Sesli Sürüş
covers.concept: A vivid green compact car with a shocked face on its rear races along a four-lane alpine obstacle course with rotating industrial hammers, ramps and a finish arch in warm daylight.

covers.title: Minecraft, PUBG
covers.concept: Voxel soldiers take cover beside an airdrop crate while parachutists descend from a cargo plane over an island village inside a closing electric-blue zone.

covers.title: Minecraft Kartopu Savaşı
covers.concept: Red and turquoise voxel teams throw bursting snowballs in a festive winter arena beneath a decorated Christmas tree and towering snowman.

covers.title: TikTok VS Profil
covers.concept: Two realistic creator portraits face off in blue and pink neon profile rings around a metallic PK emblem, audience hearts, gift boxes and a gold winner trophy.

covers.title: Profil Puanlama
covers.concept: A featured realistic creator portrait is surrounded by smaller profile medallions, audience likes and hearts, five gold stars and a large gold 9.8 rating.

covers.title: MNG Orbit
covers.concept: Colorful profile discs sweep across a dark pellet-filled arena; a large turquoise portrait consumes a smaller coral rival while equal yellow rivals burst into fragments.

covers.title: MNG Crowd Control
covers.concept: A small yellow smiley hero fires golden projectiles from a turquoise shield at surrounding red spiked profile discs, including a huge crowned boss, among blue crowd tokens.

covers.title: Şövalye Savaşı
covers.concept: Turquoise and crimson knight armies charge across a castle battlefield with swords, shields, mounted fighters, siege engines and parachuting supply chests.

covers.title: Gelene Geçene
covers.concept: A low-poly survivor with a green backpack reaches for a rescue terminal's red emergency button as angular monsters pursue through an abandoned mountain forest outpost.

covers.title: MNG Dodge Hunter
covers.concept: Glossy yellow toy ducks move along turquoise rails in a bright carnival shooting gallery; a foreground cork rifle knocks one target back in a burst of paper stars.

covers.title: Pony Katırı
covers.concept: Three expressive ponies race toward the viewer on a grassy track, led by a chestnut pony in turquoise tack with a white rival, colorful boost trails and packed grandstands.

covers.title: Vak Vak Jump
covers.concept: A bright green frog leaps toward the viewer above a rushing turquoise river, following a winding lily-pad route past water lilies, a gift crate and mountain waterfalls.

covers.title: Süper Lig (Penaltı)
covers.concept: A striker in a turquoise-and-black kit drives a football toward goal while a coral-clad goalkeeper dives across the net in a floodlit stadium filled with confetti.

covers.title: Dengesiz Yayıncı
covers.concept: A realistic mountain adventurer balances on a narrow suspended plank bridge over an alpine canyon, holding a wooden pole with two glass jars carrying unequal audience gift tokens.

covers.title: Zombie War
covers.concept: A voxel tactical survivor and glowing iron guardian defend a sunlit desert alley against advancing zombies and a giant chained mutant behind the sandstone walls.
